### Dealing with Defiance
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-june-4-2014.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 21:18-21
Points:
- Defiance creates deep domestic stress and is taken with utmost seriousness by God.
- The passage addresses an older son living under his parents' roof who insists on an unbending, insubordinate lifestyle.
- The law does not license parental mistreatment; parents only appealed to town elders after repeated efforts at correction failed.
- Parents must not sacrifice household peace and moral standards through passive indulgence.
- Unaddressed rebellion causes enduring fractures in a family and carries severe spiritual weight.

### Bible Pathways 3/8/2001
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-3-or-8-or-2001-550292.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 21:18-21
Points:
- Disrespect toward God-ordained parental authority ultimately fosters rebellion against God and society.
- Parents bear a sacred responsibility to represent Christ by training their children in righteousness.
- Parental discipline must always be delivered for loving correction rather than out of vindictiveness or anger.
- Leaving a child undisciplined leaves them unprepared for the unavoidable struggles of adult life.
- Once correction is administered, parents should promptly restore warm fellowship and express reassurance.
